questions.stem: In a patient who had a previous encounter with a specific pathogen, the immune system's ability to respond more rapidly and effectively upon re-exposure is known as immunological memory. This phenomenon involves both B cells and T cells. Regarding memory B cells, which of the following is the primary mechanism responsible for their formation? Select the most accurate option that describes the process leading to the formation of memory B cells and their role in immunological memory

options.label: C
options.text: Production of IL10 by T cells
